thread:
mike: Kicking off payments_migration_v4 during maintenance slot. Quiesce reached. Pausing at preflight to validate replica catchup and long txs.

deploybot: Deploybot: start release/payments_migration_v4 · canary=1/1 · status=quiesced

anya: quick ask: last rollout tripped on an orphaned COPY pg session. can we add a 3-minute killwatch and a whitelist for analytics jobs?

mike: yes, adding killwatch +3m. will only kill sessions older than 6m and not in the whitelist.

kevin: rollback reminder: to abort we flip feature flag, stop backfill, and run `/deploy rollback release/payments_migration_v4`. doc link: https://git.internal/playbooks/migration-rollback.md

pagerbot: Pagerbot: DB health check · primary ok · replica lag 0-2s · long_tx_count=1 (vacuum)

anya: running preflight query now: `SELECT pid, now()-state_change AS age, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ILIKE '%payments%' AND state <> 'idle';`

mike: preflight clean. acquiring advisory lock and applying concurrent index in 60s. watch p99 and write errors.

deploybot: Deploybot: advisory lock acquired · applying migration step 'add_partial_index'

kevin: p95 blip to 380ms at index start, p99 to 900ms for 20s then stabilizing.

mike: index created, starting backfill with rate 180r/s and per-tenant caps. auto-rollback condition: p99 > 1s sustained for 3m OR write-errors > 0.4% in 5m. Bot will post recommendation; human ack required to run rollback.

anya: tagging ops: @oncall-db to keep an eye. I'll also annotate services with migration_pin=true in case we need to force old behavior.

kevin: backfill 9% after 12m. no error traces. proceeding.

mike: will post final cutover note once backfill completes. keeping thread open.
